visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A professional installer wearing grey work pants and a blue shirt uses a red Milwaukee brand angle grinder. Intense yellow and orange sparks fly as the grinder cuts into the metal door lock housing. The background is a textured, light-colored hallway wall. (2) A man with short black hair and a clean-shaven face speaks enthusiastically to the camera. He wears a plain white cotton t-shirt. Colorful 2D animated confetti, stars, and red heart graphics float across the screen as he smiles. (3) The man, wearing a navy blue blazer over his white shirt and holding a black briefcase, walks through a narrow hallway towards a tan-colored metal door. The door features traditional red lunar new year decorations above a modern black smart lock. (4) Extreme close-up of the Arpha smart lock unit. The vertical rectangular device has a metallic copper-toned trim and a built-in camera lens at the top. A small screen inside the lock displays a real-time video feed of the hallway. (5) A screen recording of an iPhone interface shows the Arpha mobile application. A large circular green icon indicates 'Door Closed'. Below, menu options for 'Temporary Password' and 'Smart Linkage' are visible in Traditional Chinese text. (6) Detailed macro shot of the smart lock's surface. A single sparkling clear crystal is embedded centrally, with the brand name 'arpha' printed in white below it. A red digital arrow highlights the crystal's placement. (7) Montage sequence of the installation process. The installer's hands in grey safety gloves use a screwdriver and power tools. Blue and red sparks are emitted during the cutting phase. Various tools and a red toolbox are seen on the floor. (8) Final demonstration where the man approaches the door. The smart lock's screen activates instantly, displaying his face. The mechanical bolt slides open smoothly, and the man pushes the door to enter his home.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Loud, high-frequency screeching of a metal grinder dominates the acoustic space. An upbeat, medium-tempo electronic pop BGM with a strong rhythmic pulse and bright synthesizer pads begins simultaneously. (2) A male narrator speaks with high enthusiasm and a bright, friendly pitch. Sharp digital 'pop' and 'sparkle' SFX punctuate the start of his greeting. The music maintains a steady energetic beat. (3) The narrator's tone shifts to a professional, narrative style as he describes daily inconvenience. Clear mechanical 'thud' and 'metallic click' sounds of a door latch are layered over the continuous BGM. (4) A digital UI 'ding' sound accompanies the mention of a smartphone application. The narrator's speech is dense, featuring high articulation clarity and rising intonations for emphasis. (5) Fast-paced editing transitions are marked by subtle 'whoosh' sound effects. The BGM remains consistent in tempo and volume, providing a energetic bed for the detailed technical feature descriptions. (6) A sharp 'ding' SFX highlights the appearance of a crystal on screen. The narrator's voice exhibits high arousal as he emphasizes the aesthetic quality of the product. (7) Harsh mechanical grinding and buzzing sounds return briefly, mixed with the ongoing BGM, during the installation sequence. The vocal delivery remains confident and authoritative. (8) Final closing remarks with a persuasive and positive valence. The audio concludes with a soft mechanical deadbolt 'clack' and the BGM fading out smoothly.
